notes.title: Update 2021/08/09
notes.notes:
Patch Note

Add Feature
In lobby player customize is now available!

Until now, you may have been in trouble because you couldn't change the appearance of the character in the lobby.
From now on, you can customize your player without leaving lobby!!!

Thank you for reading our patch note.

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Update 2021/08/08
notes.notes:
Patch Note 8/8

Fix Bugs
- Don't FadeIn Change Scene with over 6 people.
- Game End after over 7 people.
We did debugging with the 8 people and found new bugs and fixed it!
Sorry if you already tried multiplayer over 6 people. But, I hope you try again!. 

Performance
- Don't sync position of poop.
It made a lot of network objects. Poops make network heavyer.


Thank you for reading our patch note!


Have a nice day!

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Bug Fix

We are very sorry about the problem.
Camera and sound and customize menu were not working.


We have fixed the problem.
There seems to be a problem with the initialization.


Please update or reinstall.

If it still doesn't work, try increasing the camera sensitivity in the settings menu.
A similar problem may occur with BGM, in which case adjust the volume in the settings menu.
